landing.headline: Control deployments, domains, services and monitoring from one console.
landing.lead: Aethra brings the Git -> build -> release -> operations cycle together: templates, per-client instances, satellite-connected VMs, TLS proxying, shared services, alerts and incident context.
landing.capabilities_headline: What an operator needs before touching production.
landing.capabilities_description: From one view you can decide what gets deployed, where it runs, how it is exposed, how it is protected and how problems are detected.

capabilities.deploy_description: Turn repositories into images, run manual or webhook builds and deploy instances with history.
capabilities.tenancy_description: Separate production, staging and previews per tenant without duplicating configuration or losing traceability.
capabilities.infrastructure_description: Register hosts, validate capacity and receive agent state so you know where each workload can run.
capabilities.access_description: Manage routes, domains, Cloudflare DNS, proxying and certificates in one operational flow.
capabilities.services_description: Provision Postgres, Redis and other backends, expose bindings and automate backups by policy.
capabilities.observability_description: Combine HTTP probes, metrics, notifications and operational context to respond faster.

landing.workflow_headline: From commit to production service without jumping between tools.

workflow.step_1: Define a template with repository, build strategy, variables and expected ports.
workflow.step_2: Trigger manual or webhook builds and keep logs, SHA, image and pipeline result.
workflow.step_3: Deploy an instance per client and environment with auto-deploy, custom domain and renewed TLS.
workflow.step_4: Watch monitors, metrics, linked services and alerts before an incident escalates.

landing.assurances_headline: An operational base for secure and continuous work.

assurances.access_description: Users, roles, TOTP and API keys reduce exposure without blocking integrations.
assurances.secrets_description: Register Git, registry, Cloudflare and SMTP credentials so modules resolve them by name.
assurances.continuity_description: Backups, retention, notifications and health states provide useful signals when something fails.

landing.preview_panel_routing_text: Hostnames, custom domains, proxying and certificates in one flow.
landing.preview_panel_services_text: Postgres and Redis with bindings, credentials and backup policies.
landing.preview_panel_context_text: Notes, facts, alerts and metrics to resolve incidents with fewer jumps.
landing.final_description: Sign in to review deploys, routes, services, monitors, alerts and operational settings.
